title: Double cross products with projections and relative Rota-Baxter operators on Hopf algebras
summary: Given a matched pair of Hopf algebras, the double cross product construction yields a new Hopf algebra, the prototypical example of which is the generalized quantum double arising from a (Hopf) skew pairing. In this paper, we specifically investigate double cross products with projections in the framework of Radford's biproduct theory, and establish that such an algebraic structure is equivalent to a simplified version of (Yetter-Drinfeld) relative Rota-Baxter operators on Hopf algebras recently introduced by Sciandra, with the corresponding braided Hopf algebras lying in the Yetter-Drinfeld…
